method: All eight actual PNGs viewed at original resolution via view_image; bounded read-only SHA256 and dimensions checked.

images.observations: Baseline Projects dialog: title and Close fit. Export button visibly truncates to Expo; Delete to Delet. Saved projects selected; no saved projects message.
Baseline confirmation body is dark text on dark gray, low contrast; OK and Cancel readable. Underlying Import truncates to Impo.

Saved projects view without confirmation overlay. Full Save a snapshot, Export project, Open selected, Delete snapshot and Close labels fit. Projects title and close X fit. One saved snapshot visible.
Transfer view without confirmation overlay. Full Copy JSON, Import project, Save a snapshot and Export project fit. JSON editor has scrollbars; footer message and Close visible without overlap.

Confirmation overlay visible: Confirm project action, fully readable wrapped replace-current-assembly-and-code message, OK and Cancel. Dark text on light background; contrast visibly improved from baseline. Overlay content and title fit.

Despite saved filename, a Delete this saved snapshot confirmation is open over Saved projects. Confirmation title, body, OK, Cancel and X fit and are readable. Underlying Projects dialog reaches right/bottom viewport edges; title readable, outer X extremely close to right edge. Footer message wraps to two lines; full Close button remains visible. Overlay prevents full saved-action control inspection.

A Delete this saved snapshot confirmation remains over transfer content. Confirmation title/body/buttons readable. Underlying transfer body and JSON editor are partially visible and clipped at scroll viewport boundary; Copy JSON and Import project controls not visible in this capture. Footer message and Close visible. Cannot certify hidden controls fit.

Large replace-current-assembly-and-code confirmation visible with readable two-line body, title, OK, Cancel and X all within viewport. Light panel and dark text readable. Underlying Projects footer and Close remain visible; underlying transfer actions not visible.

verdict: 100-percent visible label and confirmation-contrast corrections supported. 200-percent confirmation readability and footer Close visibility supported, but saved/transfer action coverage incomplete because unexpected delete confirmation overlays remain and controls are outside the captured scroll region. Full matrix pass not established.
